使用说明

  1. 该工作流程是在官方MiniMax H3 All-in-One Reference工作流程的基础上修改的，增加了自动提示节点和提示模板。

  2. 自动提示节点只能分析单幅图像。因此，在使用多图参考时，建议使用GPT、Gemini等Web平台上的提示模板，或者使用Codex、Claude等代理。

    （语言模型下载链接：https://huggingface.co/AVert888/Qwen3.5-9B-mmproj-q8_0-GGUF)

  3. 通过修改数值来调整分辨率，并在工作流程中提供详细说明。

  4. H3模型下载链接：https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3

    可用型号和 VRAM 要求：

    • minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors： 12GB 显存

    • minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot.safetensors： 16GB 显存

    • minimax_h3_ref2va_bf16.safetensors：16GB+ 显存

    请根据您的硬件配置进行选择。

    运行时参考（基于 RTX 5060 Ti 16GB + 32GB RAM）：

    生成 10 秒 480p 视频minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot.safetensors大约需要 950 秒。

  5. 建议先尝试免费的在线版本。如果您对结果满意，可以在本地部署。

    免费在线工作流程：https://www.runninghub.ai/post/2079133532412309506/?inviteCode=rh-v1443

o.en:
Instructions

  1. This workflow is modified based on the official MiniMax H3 All-in-One Reference workflow, with added automatic prompt nodes and prompt templates.

  2. The automatic prompt node can only analyze a single image. Therefore, when using multi-image reference, it is recommended to use the prompt template on web platforms such as GPT and Gemini, or with agents like Codex and Claude.

    (Language model download link:https://huggingface.co/AVert888/Qwen3.5-9B-mmproj-q8_0-GGUF)

  3. Resolution is adjusted by modifying numerical values, with detailed explanations provided within the workflow.

  4. H3 model download link:https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3

    Available model variants and VRAM requirements:

    • minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors: 12GB VRAM

    • minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot.safetensors: 16GB VRAM

    • minimax_h3_ref2va_bf16.safetensors: 16GB+ VRAM

    Please select according to your hardware configuration.

    Runtime reference (based on RTX 5060 Ti 16GB + 32GB RAM):

    Generating a 10-second 480p video withminimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot.safetensorstakes approximately 950 seconds.

  5. It is recommended to try the free online version first. If you are satisfied with the results, you may deploy it locally.

    Free online workflow:https://www.runninghub.ai/post/2079133532412309506/?inviteCode=rh-v1443
